description.narrative: Country portfolio budget - CPB Sudan 2019-2026 : Provide pre-primary and primary school children with nutrition sensitive school meals sourced locally through Home-Grown School Feeding approaches complimented with other school health and nutrition services including capacity strengthening support for relevant stakeholders.

sector.narrative: By 2030, end all forms of malnutrition, including achieving, by 2025, the internationally agreed targets on stunting and wasting in children under 5 years of age, and address the nutritional needs of adolescent girls, pregnant and lactating women and older persons
